description: This file declares utility functions for managing Cuttlefish instances, such as stopping and killing processes associated with Cuttlefish virtual devices.

methods.name: KillAllCuttlefishInstances
methods.description: Runs stop_cvd for all Cuttlefish instances found based on run_cvd processes and sends SIGKILL to these processes.

parameters.name: clear_runtime_dirs
parameters.description: Indicates whether to clear runtime directories after stopping instances.

methods.name: ForcefullyStopGroup
methods.description: Forcefully stops all processes within a specified user group.

parameters.name: any_id_in_group
parameters.description: User ID representing the group to stop.
